name: karunya-bus-tracking-portal
description: Karunya Bus Tracking Portal - MERN stack project for Karunya Institute of Technology and Sciences, Coimbatore

scripts.install-all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.render-build: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run server" "npm run client"
